journey.title: Your 4-Step Care Journey with Mend Sure
journey.subtitle: We handle every clinical and logistical detail so you can focus entirely on healing and recovery.
journey.step1Text: Share your medical reports securely. Our partner specialists review your case and send back a treatment plan and second opinion.
journey.step2Text: Choose from accredited hospitals matched precisely to your condition, budget, and preferred destination city.
journey.step3Text: We handle medical visa invitation letters, airport pickups, recovery accommodation, and priority hospital admission.
journey.step4Text: Continuous follow-up care, physical therapy coordination, and check-ins after you return safely to your home country.

services.title: Our Services Cover Every Need
services.subtitle: From your first medical opinion to private nursing during recovery, every part of your treatment journey is arranged for you.
services.opinionText: Share your reports and receive a verified second opinion from our specialists, with itemized, all-in pricing before you commit to anything.
services.preTravelText: Talk to your treating doctor by video before you fly, so the treatment plan, timeline, and fitness to travel are settled in advance.
services.visaText: Medical visa invitation letters, documentation checklists, and embassy liaison for you and your accompanying attendant.
services.moneyText: Guidance on authorised currency exchange and secure payment channels, so you get fair rates without carrying unnecessary cash.
services.interpreterText: Language support in the consultation room and on the ward, plus translation of medical records and discharge summaries.
services.transportText: Airport pickup and drop, hospital transfers, and local travel arranged around your appointment and treatment schedule.
services.stayText: Verified stays near your hospital across budgets — guest houses, serviced apartments, and hotels for you and your family.
services.admissionText: Priority admission, appointment scheduling with your consultant, and help sourcing prescribed medication during and after your stay.
services.nursingText: Trained attendants and nurses for bedside care in hospital or at your accommodation through the recovery period.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about medical travel, costs, safety, and second opinions.
faq.a1: Fill out the consultation form on this page with your condition and any medical reports you have. Our care team reviews it and sends back a treatment plan with clear, all-in pricing — usually within 48 hours.
faq.a2: Coverage varies by insurer and hospital. Once you share your policy details with our care team, we'll confirm what's covered before you commit to anything.
faq.q3: What support do you provide for traveling patients?
faq.a3: Medical visa assistance, accommodation options, airport transfers, and interpreter services — all coordinated so your trip is as stress-free as the treatment itself.
faq.q4: Can I get a cost estimate before I travel?
faq.a4: Yes — that's the whole point of the free quote. You'll see itemized, all-in pricing based on your specific case before you book a single flight.
